name: Discord
refreshNote: No official re-scrape tool. Discord caches link embeds server-side; append a query string (e.g. ?v=2) to force a fresh fetch. The Discordbot support article says images/videos are proxied and cached for a while through Discord's servers.
notes: Official: support article 'About Discord Link Previews and the Discordbot' describes Discordbot fetching title/description/image only when a link is posted, and proxying media through Discord's servers; it does not document individual tags.

Layout (secondary sources): coloured left bar (meta theme-color), site name (og:site_name, small) above a bold linked title, description, then image. theme-color is a Discord-specific behaviour among these platforms.
Large vs small: twitter:card=summary_large_image puts a large image below the text; otherwise og:image is a small (~80x80) thumbnail to the right (secondary sources).

Truncation: title 256 is the documented embed-object limit from Discord's API docs (applies to embeds, assumed for link previews); description ~350 chars is a secondary-source estimate for link previews (API embeds allow 4096).

No documented image minimum/max bytes for link embeds (null). Recommended 1200x630 is a common secondary recommendation. webp in og:image is believed to render (Discord's media proxy serves webp) but there are community reports of problems with (animated) webp - uncertain. SVG not rendered (estimate).

Verification method: official doc pages were located via web search (search-engine extracts of the official URLs listed in source); direct page fetches of the official domain were blocked from the research environment, so wording could not be re-read in full.
